lines.en: Stop here. Let's wait on the sidewalk.
Why, Grandma? The road is empty.
The signal is red. Red means wait.
Oh, a car is coming fast!
Yes. Traffic is busy at this hour.
Is the signal green now?
Yes. Look left and right, then cross carefully.
lines.ko: 네. 왼쪽 오른쪽을 보고, 조심해서 건너요.

lines.en: Last week a bicycle came very close to me.
lines.ko: 지난주에 자전거가 제 옆으로 아주 가까이 지나갔어요.

lines.en: That's why we cross carefully. Will you remember?
lines.ko: 그래서 우리가 조심해서 건너는 거예요. 기억할 거죠?

lines.en: Yes, Grandma. I will always wait for green.
Hello? I want to report a small accident.
Yes, Ma'am. Where did it happen?
On the big road, near the traffic signal.
What happened? Is everyone okay?
A car hit a bicycle a minute ago.
lines.ko: 일 분 전에 자동차가 자전거를 쳤어요.

lines.en: Is the bicycle broken? Is the person hurt?
No. Everyone is standing on the sidewalk now.
lines.ko: 아니요. 모두 지금 인도에 서 있어요.

lines.en: Good. Please wait there. We will come quickly.
lines.ko: 다행이에요. 거기서 기다려 주세요. 빨리 갈게요.

lines.en: Okay. The traffic is slow, so drive carefully.
Thank you for calling. You did the right thing today.
lines.ko: 신고해 주셔서 고마워요. 오늘 정말 잘하셨어요.
